body:
FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING, B-HC10-120, agent 120) — growth-project-mobile#370 @ c7014623520baf23a697f4d646e3d80a423789c5

Opening of H8, stacked on #369 (base `agent119/wear-split-7-signout-durable` @ `a2bfe2fa906ff5e3b991613a6838a82456db920c`, its FIX ROUND 2 head). Fixes the two ruled follow-ups of #360, C-360-1 and C-360-2 ([recorded counterexample and fix rule](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/360#issuecomment-5976279445), carried in AUD-SOL-H23-118 lines 45-46 and AUD-OPUS-W12-116 line 60). No change to #359-#369 code, no backend change: the backend skips a sample whose key (user, provider, metric, start, end) it already holds (backend main `ee55f814`, `dedup.util.ts`, unique `dedup_key`, `createMany` with `skipDuplicates`), so a re-read is safe.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failing before → passing after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| C-360-1: a sample written after the last sync with an event time before the overlap (5 min Health Connect, 60 min Apple Health) is never read | `syncWindows.ts` `LATE_DATA_LOOKBACK_MINUTES = 24 * 60`, used by both services as the re-read overlap. Apple Health steps and active energy (hourly sums, the backend keeps the first value) post only once their hour ended 2 hours before the read, and their progress stops at that settled hour | test `206ee7cb`, fix `d01d0a85` | `healthConnectSyncService.h8` C-360-1 (2: sleep written after waking, which is the recorded counterexample; a watch record 20 h late); `healthKitSyncService.h8` C-360-1 (2: heart rate 5 h late; hourly steps post once, settled, with the late share) |
| C-360-2: an import interrupted mid-way re-reads everything already posted | Health Connect reads one page at a time (oldest first, up to `MAX_READ_PAGES` per type per run) and saves that type's progress after every page; Apple Health reads oldest first in pieces of at most a day and saves after every piece that posted. Fence before every read, request and save. Later passes in one visit read only types left at the page bound; Apple Health runs one pass | test `206ee7cb`, fix `d01d0a85` | `healthConnectSyncService.h8` C-360-2 (4: failed POST on page 3, failed read on page 3, sign-out while page 2 is read, resume-only pass); `healthKitSyncService.h8` C-360-2 (5: contiguous day pieces, failed POST and failed read in piece 3, metric failure in piece 2, sign-out in piece 2); `onDeviceSync` H8 passes (4) |
| Follow-on of the above in existing tests | Apple Health session-change case keyed on the first request instead of a check count (pieces add checks); a stubbed Health Connect result without type lists keeps the earlier pass rule (the ConnectProviderSheet suites stub the service) | test `530438ae`, fix `c7014623` | `healthKitSyncService` A-317-1 session change; `ConnectProviderSheet.importEpoch` (3), `ConnectProviderSheet.attemptFence` (1): fail at `d01d0a85` ([lane 37347255419](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37347255419), PR CI [37347337167](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37347337167)), pass at the head |

Failing before: [lane 37346786381](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37346786381) at `206ee7cb` (tests only): 843 pass / 24 fail (every H8 case, the Apple Health suite fails to load the new constants, plus the 5 by-design probe failures below). Passing after: [lane 37349349960](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37349349960) at `c7014623`: 879 pass / 5 fail, only the by-design probe failures.

**Probe replay** (79 specs: every H1-H8 wearables and health suite, every earlier probe from both lenses, the H7-120 probes, plus the H8 files):

| Lens | Probe | At the head |
|---|---|---|
| Sol H7-120 | `authActions.interruptedAuthority.sol120` (all cases, incl. B-369-2 interrupted signOut at session read / authority creation) | pass |
| Sol earlier | `authActions.storageOutage.sol119g`, `onDeviceState.failedGrantChain.sol119f`, `authActions.restartGrant.sol119f`, `authActions.restartOriginal.sol119f`, `onDeviceState.progressSession.sol119g`, `useWearableConnections.sol118` / `.sol119` / `.transportSol119`, `disconnectRetry.sol119`, `ConnectionsScreen.sol118`, `ConnectionsScreen.emptyImport.probe`, `WearablesShell.settingsReturn.probe`, `audit364.samsungRetirement.hc4` | pass |
| Sol H6-118 | `audit364.samsungRetirement` original SAMSUNG_HEALTH expectation | fail, by design since H6 (`.hc4` copy passes) |
| Opus H7-120 | `onDeviceState.opus120`, `authActions.opus120`, `onDeviceCopy.opus120` (DOCUMENTS C-369-5) | pass |
| Opus earlier | `onDeviceState.opus119e`, `useWearableConnections.opus119` / `.opus119d`, `hcPrivacyTemplate.opus119`, `healthConnectRationale.opus118`, `ConnectionsScreen.samsungRow.opus118` | pass |
| Opus H46F | `onDeviceState.opus119f` DOCUMENTS C-362-14 / C-362-15 | fail, by design since H7 (flipped copy passes) |
| Opus H46F | `onDeviceState.opus119f` and `.flipped` "CLOSED C-362-12" | fail on the in-flight write resolving only: since #369 FIX ROUND 2 it rejects as stopped; `.hc11` copy with the same end-state assertions passes |

**Money list self-check**
- Webhook order/redelivery: no webhooks; a re-read sample is a redelivery to ingest, skipped by the backend dedup key (verified on backend main).
- Concurrency and lock order: unchanged chain; every page or piece save goes through `setSyncProgress` (the sign-out epoch chain) after `assertCurrent`, so no save lands after sign-out starts.
- Terminal states: a type is complete only when its last page or the window end was read and posted; a read failure leaves it incomplete; a stop rejects with no save after it.
- Pagination/fail-closed completeness: the page bound per run is unchanged (20); a type at the bound keeps a resume token and the result is incomplete; a progress value only moves forward.
- Currency/minor units: not touched.
- Copy truth: no copy changed; "incomplete" still means a later visit reads more.

**Pre-push checklist**
- No free-form text or PII to logs or Sentry: the Health Connect read-failure log still names only the record type, whether it resumed, and the closed error class.
- Identity re-checked after awaits before state writes: `assertCurrent` before every read, request and progress save; `throwIfStopped` after every native read.
- Cancellation races tested: sign-out while page 2 / piece 2 is read keeps page 1 / piece 1 saved and saves nothing after.
- Copy rules: no copy.
- Failing-before test per finding: C-360-1 and C-360-2 cases fail at `206ee7cb`, pass at the head.
- Size: 890+/160- = 1,050 changed lines (under 1,500); production 492 lines in 5 files, tests 558 lines in 5 files.

**Operator decisions (recommended default first)**
1. Look-back 1 day (default) vs longer.
2. Apple Health hourly sums settle 2 hours (default): a steps or energy hour shows at the first refresh 2-3 hours after it ends; a share written later still misses that hour. Lasting fix: backend replace of on-device hourly sums.
3. Backend replace keyed on (provider, source record id) for Health Connect records rewritten in place (ticket).

**Follow-ups (C):** H8-C1 Health Connect record rewritten in place keeps its first value or adds a row (backend replace); H8-C2 hourly share later than 2 h (backend replace, then settle 0); H8-C3 progress saved in the future after a clock change is not healed (clamp to now when read); H8-C4 Health Connect changes tokens instead of the day re-read.

PR CI at `c7014623520baf23a697f4d646e3d80a423789c5`: Typecheck, lint, test **success** ([run 37349317509](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37349317509)). Analyze absent on the stacked base.

READY FOR AUDIT
